# VideoReduce.com

> Free, private, browser-based video compression and media editing suite powered by WebAssembly.

## Overview
VideoReduce.com provides 100% client-side video and audio processing utilities. All media operations execute locally inside the user's web browser using FFmpeg compiled to WebAssembly (Wasm) with SIMD multi-threading. Zero bytes of media data are ever transmitted or uploaded to remote cloud servers.

## Core Capabilities
- **Video Compression**: Reduce video file size up to 90% without visible quality loss using Constant Rate Factor (CRF) and dynamic bitrate ceilings.
- **Platform Presets**: One-click target size presets for Discord (8MB / 25MB), WhatsApp (16MB), and Email attachments.
- **Format Conversion**: Transcode between MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV, and AVI.
- **Audio Extraction**: Extract audio tracks from video files as MP3, AAC, and WAV.
- **GIF Generation**: High-quality two-pass GIF conversion with palettegen/paletteuse.
- **Privacy Shield**: Strip sensitive Exif, GPS, device, and metadata from videos before sharing.
